title: Comparative evaluation and optimization of microwave and ultrasound assisted extraction of stevia secondary bioactive compounds using RSM and ANN–GA approaches
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,2170-2191
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00329F, Paper

Prakash Kumar, Punyadarshini Punam Tripathy
MAE and UAE offer efficient and eco-friendly alternatives for bioactive extraction. Under ANN–GA optimization, MAE yielded 8.66% higher TPC, 4.60% higher TFC, and 5.01% greater antioxidant activity, while reducing extraction time by 60.38%.
